cases.title: Test user cannot sign in
cases.scenario: One fictional requester reports a locked lab account.
cases.resolution_plan: Verify identity using the documented simulated process; distinguish lockout from password expiry; record authorized lab recovery and requester confirmation.

cases.title: One workstation cannot resolve internal names
cases.scenario: Synthetic workstation reports name-resolution failure while IP connectivity works.
cases.resolution_plan: Record the IP-versus-name diagnostic distinction; attach synthetic command output explicitly labelled; propose correcting the lab DNS setting and verify within the scenario.

cases.title: Department print queue paused
cases.scenario: A fictional team cannot print; an alternate printer is available.
cases.resolution_plan: Document scope and workaround, investigate the simulated queue, record recovery and confirmation without claiming a real printer repair.

cases.title: Request for an approved PDF reader
cases.scenario: One fictional employee requests an existing approved free application.
cases.resolution_plan: Record approval and software-source validation; close with a simulated installation checklist and explicit no-real-deployment label.

cases.title: Suspicious invoice email reported
cases.scenario: A synthetic email uses an example.invalid URL; no live message or payload is sent.
cases.resolution_plan: Record safe triage, no-link-click advice, preserved synthetic indicators and escalation to the fictional security team; track acknowledgment.

cases.title: Shared folder access request
cases.scenario: A fictional requester needs read-only access to a synthetic team folder.
cases.resolution_plan: Record business-owner approval, least-privilege scope and simulated verification. Do not grant access to any actual directory or AD group.

cases.title: Low disk space warning
cases.scenario: Synthetic storage report shows low space on one endpoint.
cases.resolution_plan: Categorize data before proposed cleanup, exclude user documents, document the simulated recovery result; do not delete host files.

cases.title: VPN disconnects repeatedly
cases.scenario: One fictional remote requester reports intermittent VPN disconnects.
cases.resolution_plan: Record collection of timestamps and sanitized error details, temporary workaround and escalation; demonstrate a pending-information state before resolution.

cases.title: Meeting microphone issue reopened
cases.scenario: A synthetic audio issue initially appears solved, then recurs.
cases.resolution_plan: Demonstrate solved then reopened workflow, capture the second diagnosis and fresh requester validation; retain both attempts in the audit trail.

cases.title: Fictional shared application unavailable
cases.scenario: Multiple synthetic users cannot use an internal training application.
cases.resolution_plan: Record major-impact prioritization, assignment and escalation, simulated stakeholder updates and restored-service confirmation. Do not claim real outage metrics.
